author: Leena Nasir
title: Scarlett Johansson Slams Fans In Outwardly Arrogant Statement | The Daily Caller
text:
Scarlett Johansson put her arrogance on full display by issuing an unhinged statement about her celebrity status.
Clearly setting her bar as low as it can go, she casually blurted the selfish comments during the interview for her In Style cover story . The publication revealed Johansson’s bizarre personal policy to not take photographs with her adoring fans unless she’s at an event, but it didn’t stop there. After admitting she didn’t care enough to pose with the very people who elevated her to superstardom and the lavish life she enjoys, Johansson launched into a self-indulgent display of arrogance.
“I always say to people, ‘I’m not working.’ [And that means] I don’t want to be identified as being in this time and place with you. I’m doing my own thing,” she told In Style.
BERLIN, GERMANY – JULY 10: US-danish Scarlett Johansson attends the “To The Moon” premiere at Zoo Palast on July 10, 2024 in Berlin, Germany. (Photo by Tristar Media/Getty Images)
Johansson, famous for roles in “Black Widow,” “Avengers” and “Captain America: Civil War,” made it clear that she was simply not interested in engaging with fans unless it was on her own terms .
“It really offends a lot of people,” she admitted.
“It doesn’t mean I’m not appreciative, of course, that people are fans, or happy to see me.”
Her attempt to defend her distorted perception did little to redeem the star, but she kept on talking about her challenges with fame.
BERLIN, GERMANY – JULY 10: US-danish Scarlett Johansson attends the “To The Moon” premiere at Zoo Palast on July 10, 2024 in Berlin, Germany. (Photo by Tristar Media/Getty Images)
“I like to be in my own thoughts that have nothing to do with what other people think of me,” she said, seemingly unaware of the career choice she made.
“I don’t like being self-conscious,” she told In Style. (RELATED: ‘It Makes Me Sick!’: Mariah Carey Goes On Wild Rant That Really Lets Out Her Inner Diva)
I don’t think Johansson has a lot to worry about anymore. The people who did follow her career have likely just been turned away. It’s hard to imagine fans will care much about her anymore.
